objective:
Take this network from 20th to first on paradigm.xyz/puzzles/amm. Board entry IB = 522.00; 10th is 524.66 (+2.7 over IB); 1st 528.40 (+6.4). This goal enters nothing.
READ FIRST: B/README.md with B=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gtmcknight/amm-sim/e65314f88de945f6d055bfc2aab01c482ab6570e/research/solved and get the folder: curl -LsSf $B/fetch.sh -o fetch.sh && sh fetch.sh $B scratch/solved. It holds the game solved with perfect information (+8.70 over HA, this network's earlier head, on the replica; IB is +0.59 over HA), the tables, and reference Python that runs them on afterSwap inputs alone: +3.77 over HA with a Gaussian price filter, +4.26 with a lattice filter, about 7th on the board. With the true arb/retail flag the same code scores +6.98, level with 1st. Two things stand between this network and first: see "Two tracks for a goal" and run both from episode 1, about half the items each. Plan with its "Fleet rules": what blocked a third of an earlier goal's results on this fleet.
TRACK A, the contract: reproduce gates.py; compress the tables on the replica; port the Gaussian policy to Solidity (fees within 0.01 bps of real.py on the callbacks of 20 replica runs, afterSwap peak <= 245,000, 0 OutOfGas, no revert, amm-match validate passes); then the port and IB, each alone against VanillaStrategy on the same fresh engine seeds from 12000000 up, never reused, in 64-seed commands: paired{n,mean_diff,se,sum,sumsq,worst5}, gas_stats(). Bar: +2.7 over IB on 4,000 seeds.
TRACK B, arb or retail, plain Python on the replica: the reference misreads 16% of the first trades of a step, and reading them right is worth +2.72. One idea per item, measured alone with run.py and pair.py (blind: a policy sees only afterSwap inputs), tuned on replica seeds from 60000 and scored once on 10000..12047 against ref/lattice_qm.json. The README lists five ideas and what already failed; two items are told to skip that list and start fresh. Early item: a numba port of replica2.py + latt.py that matches gates.py. Whatever B wins by 0.3 goes into A's next port.
SEATS: no item blocks on speed. A seat that is slow or not Linux x86_64 takes Track B or compression, which need only python3.
FILES: IB = `code_zb64` of https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/afd5183e9ff3235334e041c00b0cd19079599a2c6464db95f8c1586712105557; `port_zb64` is its Python port.
ENGINE: amm_sim_rs.run_batch(X, VanillaStrategy, configs, 8), configs per MatchRunner._build_configs. No command over 8 minutes: segment (run.py takes seed ranges, dp.py resumes with DP_STATE), save state under scratch/.
